rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for treating someone leniently or forgivingly.

example.english: Mum indulgently forgave me for being late this time.
example.traditional: 阿媽寬容咁原諒咗我今次遲到。
example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 fun1 jung4 gam3 jyun4 loeng6 zo2 ngo5 gam1 ci3 ci4 dou3

rows.note: Use this when the indulgence specifically means allowing A to do V without enforcing limits.

example.english: The boss indulgently let us leave work early today.
example.traditional: 老闆由得我哋今日早啲收工。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 jau4 dak1 ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 zou2 di1 sau1 gung1
